characters.name: In General
characters.description: Amazing Technicolor Wildlife: That's DEFINITELY one colorful cast right there.

characters.name: Peanut Otter
characters.description: All That Glitters: He gets a new pair of Airplane Shoes in "These Shoes Are Made for Walking" but goes back to his old ones by the end of the episode. Amazing Technicolor Wildlife: He is a red otter. Artistic License – Biology: In "Peanut the Mama", a baby turtle implements on him as his mother. In real life, parenthood is almost nonexistent in turtles, as they abandon their eggs after laying and burying them. Of course, this would not translate well in a kid's show with anthropomorphic animals, though it would have worked better with a bird or a crocodile. Baseball Episode: "Mama Peanut" revolves around him playing baseball with Munchy and Flick. Big, Thin, Short Trio: He is the Big to Jelly's Thin and Butter's short.

characters.name: Jelly Otter
characters.description: Amazing Technicolor Wildlife: She is a fuchsia/violet otter. Are You Pondering What I'm Pondering?: She's definitely this in "Babbleberry Day" and other episodes to the point where it becomes aRunning Gag. In the aforementioned story, after she gets the idea to help with babbleberry picking:Jelly: Are you thinkin' what I'm thinkin'?Peanut: How cool it would be to have central hot chocolate?Jelly: No! Beautiful Singing Voice: She's somewhat of a talented singer. Bonus points in that her voice actress would later become a singer herself. Big Little Brother: Despite being Peanut's younger sister, she is slightly taller than him. Big, Thin, Short Trio: She is the Thin to Peanut's Big and Butter's Small.

characters.name: Baby Butter Otter
characters.description: The Baby of the Bunch: She's a baby, and the youngest out of all the kids. Big, Thin, Short Trio: She is the Short to Peanut's Big and Jelly's Thin. Clingy Child: She becomes very clingy to her mom in "Come Back, Mama" when she learns that she has to go away for the day. Filthy Fun: She loves playing in the mud, which is a big problem in one story because it's picture day and Peanut and Jelly need to try to keep her clean. As explained in the "Good Clean Fun" song:PeanutandJelly: ''She's only happy when she's...Butter: Gooey! Forgiveness: Due to her sweet, innocent nature, she forgave both Peanut and Jelly for being mean to her and the lightning bug in "This Little Light of Mine", and she also forgave Flick for teasing her in "Butter Tags Along".

characters.name: Opal Otter
characters.description: Accessory-Wearing Cartoon Animal: Aside from wearing slippers, she wears a pair of glasses and an apron. She even sometimes wears a shell necklace that doubles as a clock. Alliterative Name:OpalOtter. Amazing Technicolor Wildlife: She is a purple otter. Babysitting Episode: She babysits the newborn muskrat triplets in "Three's a Crowd", giving her own three children a taste ofInfant Sibling Jealousywithout introducing a new sibling. Foolish Husband, Responsible Wife: She's more of the serious type unlike her husband, but you can't deny how much of a perfect couple they are.

characters.name: Ernest Otter
characters.description: Accessory-Wearing Cartoon Animal: Aside from wearing shoes, he wears a red necktie. Amazing Technicolor Wildlife: He is a blue-gray otter. Blue Is Heroic: He's a blue otter who is also a good father to the main protagonists. The Cameo:Quaildogappears on one of the comics displayed on his magazine stand. Foolish Husband, Responsible Wife: He can be a little goofy when compared to his wife, who is the more serious type.

characters.name: Pinch Raccoon
characters.description: Amazing Technicolor Wildlife: She is a blue raccoon. Blue Is Heroic: As a blue raccoon, she is one of the main protagonists as well as Jelly's best friend. Bows for Cuteness: She wears a pink bow on her head to represent her cute, girly appearance. Forgiveness: She forgives Munchy in "Dollhouse Disaster" for eating her dollhouse. Girly Girl: She loves wearing pink and dressing up in ribbons, curls, and jewelry to hold tea parties for her dolls.

characters.name: Scootch Raccoon
characters.description: Amazing Technicolor Wildlife: Like his sister, he is also a blue raccoon. Annoying Younger Sibling: He is always causing trouble with his older sister Pinch, and even friends, due to him unable to control his energy. It doesn't help that he's aKarma Houdini. Apologizes a Lot: Specifically, he always runs at people or things, bowling them over or knocking them down.Scootch: Sorry, sorry, my fault. Catchphrase: "Yahhhhh!...sorry, sorry, my fault." Character Development: He becomes better behaved later on in the show as he doesn't cause massive destruction like he did before.

characters.name: Munchy Beaver
characters.description: Birthday Episode: He turns 8 years old in "Big Beaver Day", where he is assigned more grown-up responsibilities. Disappeared Dad: His father has been mentioned several times but is never seen. It's implied that his parents are divorced (another character comments that Munchy's dad doesn't live with them anymore.) Furry Reminder: He has a fondness for eating logs. It's Okay to Cry: He learns this in "Munchy's Sinking Feeling" as it's okay to cry when you're really upset about something. Meaningful Name: As a beaver, he likes to munch on almost anything wooden.

characters.name: Flick Duck
characters.description: Acrophobic Bird: As a duck, he can fly, but he's just afraid of heights. He eventually gets over this in order to grant the wish of a new friend during Hoohaw Hoo in the episode "The Ice Moose". Are We There Yet?: The opening of the "When Are We Gonna Get There?" song opens with him asking this question and then the group singing a song asking about just when they're going to get where they're going. Artistic License – Biology: "Nothing but the Tooth" has him lose one of his baby teeth. Ducks don't have teeth in real life. Bindle Stick: When he fantasizes about running away in "Ducking Out on Valentine's Day," there is one sitting next to him in the train he's riding on. Breaking the Fourth Wall: The viewer gets a babbleberry pie in the face when he drops it during the intro.

characters.name: Ootsie and Bootsie Snootie
characters.description: Advanced Tech 2000: A fairly regularRunning Gagis them having new toys which are named in this manner. They'll usually comment that they're twice as good as the 1000. Amazing Technicolor Wildlife: They are purple and pink poodles, respectively. The Bully: Just like Flick, they can be thisDepending on the Writeras they are often mean to PB&J and their friends. Despite this, PB&J and the others still help them when they have a problem. Company Cross-References: In "Too Hot for Fishsicles", Bootsie calls a specific shade of white "snow white", not so subtly referencing to Disney'sfirst animated film. A Dog Named "Dog": They were shown to have originally owned Bubbles and called him "Fish".

characters.name: Mayor Jeff
characters.description: Accessory-Wearing Cartoon Animal: He wears glasses and a hat. Amazing Technicolor Wildlife: He is a blue otter. Babysitting Episode: He babysits the Otter kids in "Otterly Alone" when Opal has to take care of Aunt Nanner, who is sick with the flu. Collector of the Strange: He collects toilet seat covers and seems a tad too obsessed with them. Apparently, he really likes bathroom fixtures because another episode shows his houseboat being full of sinks. Economy Cast: Fanon holds that he has been mayor for an ungodly amount of time.

characters.name: Cap'n Crane
characters.description: Alliterative Name:Cap'nCrane. Catchphrase: "(honk) Watchbird alert! Watchbird alert!" Foolish Husband, Responsible Wife: He's portrayed as dimwitted while his wife Connie is more sensible. Glad I Thought of It: This gem from "Gotta Dance":Cap'n Crane: Watchbird alert! Watchbird alert! Wanda Raccoon just dropped all the pies into Lake Hoohaw. Hoo hoo. Connie, what are they going to do now?Connie Crane: I guess they could think of another kind of contest.Cap'n Crane: I've got it! They could think of another kind of contest! (Connie looks aggrieved.) No Full Name Given: His first name is never revealed.

characters.name: Connie Crane
characters.description: Accessory-Wearing Cartoon Animal: She is almost seen always wearing a pink hat, blue scarf, and sunglasses. Alliterative Name:ConnieCrane. Breaking the Fourth Wall: She briefly looks at the audience at one point when snarking that she's married to "a cuckoo clock" when her husband won't stop announcing the time. Deadpan Snarker: She's aware her husband, Cap'n, is an idiot at times, and just has fun with it. Facewing: In "I'll Be Your Best Friend" when her husband falls into the lake after craning to get a look at Bucky Spacebeaver's showboat.
